excerpt.zh:
我们母星所能提供的资源也就只能支持我们走到这一步。我们的产业需要扩张到外星，这就需要有一艘£construction_ship£工程船。

如果我们收集到了足够的£alloys£合金，就赶紧[GetBuildGrow]一艘。
excerpt.en:
The resources generated by our homeworld will only take us so far. Our industry needs to expand off-world, and that requires a £construction_ship£ Construction Ship.

We should [GetBuildGrow] one as soon as we have amassed enough £alloys£ Alloys to do so.
